Browse events by tag

Tags organize every Chattanooga event into two groups: genre and place. Genre tags sort by type: music, food, outdoors, sports, arts, and more. Place tags filter by venue or neighborhood, so you can find everything happening at a specific spot. Each tag shows a live count of upcoming events. Use them to skip straight to what interests you instead of scrolling the full list. Browse both groups below, or sort by count to see what's most active right now.
